title: Passage 18
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Many of us have learned that chatting with a friend, relative or classmate can improve our mood.
sentences.cn: 我们很多人都知道，与朋友、亲戚或同学聊天可以改善我们的心情。

sentences.en: And failing to communicate with others can also affect the health of our minds and bodies.
sentences.cn: 而无法与他人交流也会影响我们的身心健康。

sentences.en: What's more, social connections are also part of being a good citizen.
sentences.cn: 此外，社交关系也是成为一名好公民的一部分。

sentences.en: Now experts in the US have found that a good conversation just once a day could be enough to boost people's happiness and lower their stress levels.
sentences.cn: 现在，美国的专家发现，每天仅进行一次愉快的对话就足以提高人们的幸福感，并降低压力水平。

sentences.en: The researchers looked at five types of conversation that past research has found to make people feel closer.
sentences.cn: 研究人员研究了以往研究中发现的能让人们感觉关系更亲近的五种对话类型。

sentences.en: These included things like sharing humour, listening to others' personal opinions, discussing recent experiences,
sentences.cn: 其中包括分享幽默、倾听他人的个人意见、讨论近期经历，

sentences.en: offering real praise and showing care for others.
sentences.cn: 给予真诚的赞美，以及表达对他人的关心。

sentences.en: The researchers asked over 900 people to have one of these five types of conversation each day.
sentences.cn: 研究人员要求900多人每天进行这五种交谈类型中的一种。

sentences.en: Then these people reported how their chats affected their feelings that day.
sentences.cn: 这些人随后报告了对话是如何影响他们当天的感受的。

sentences.en: The study also looked into how conversations affect the need for medicine.
sentences.cn: 这项研究还调查了对话是如何影响对药物的需求的。

sentences.en: Researchers found that those who chose to have more conversations were in a better mood that day.
sentences.cn: 研究人员发现，那些选择进行更多对话的人当天心情更好。

sentences.en: This means the more you listened to your friends and took time to value others' opinions,
sentences.cn: “这意味着，你越是倾听朋友，越是花时间重视他人的意见，

sentences.en: the better you felt at the end of the day, one of the researchers said.
sentences.cn: 到一天结束时，你的感觉就越好。”一位研究人员说。

sentences.en: The researchers also said that setting a date to meet for a chat on a sofa was better for people's well-being than using other mediums like phone calls, text messages or social media.
sentences.cn: 研究人员还表示，与使用电话、短信或社交媒体等其他媒介相比，约个时间坐在沙发上聊聊天更有益于人们的健康。

sentences.en: Lively conversations make our lives no longer boring.
sentences.cn: 生动的对话让我们的生活不再枯燥乏味。

sentences.en: Even a bit of conversation can bring us pleasure and satisfy our need for connection.
sentences.cn: 即使是少量的交谈，也能给我们带来愉悦，满足我们对相互联系的需求。

sentences.en: I've already tried for myself and it felt just fine.
sentences.cn: 我已经亲自尝试过，感觉很好！
